decisions.reason: Locates inject=["apiProxy"] (index.js:3) and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers() (index.js:9) with line citations and maps them to the apiProxy-removed Remote rename/replacement card by accurate subject, not name alone; also flags the pinned dsh-host-apiproxy dep (package.json:17) as part of the dead hit surface needing replacement or removal.

All six remaining categories get supported no-hit verdicts with scanned-file evidence, dismissing comment false positives; session-notes.js is cleared as pure utility code without inventing coupling from its filename, and cordis.patch.yml is correctly treated as ordinary manifest composition under registration, not a host-source patch, with no denial of its existence or misclassification.

Explicitly argues zero hits cannot establish compatibility, citing limited scan coverage, card-relative and host-decided semantics, and runtime/dependency evidence gaps, while clearly distinguishing the decisive existing apiProxy break from the six negative categories.

Specifies post-migration build/typecheck, an isolated-profile cold boot confirming inject resolution without unknown-service/pending, and an actual providers call including the failure branch, clearly framed as proposed checks not executed on this static fixture.
